title: 第六章 纨绔的正确打开方式
novel_title: 纨绔女修四处撩，绿茶狼崽黑化了
content_zh:
萧姚盯着监控中的一片狼藉，眉头紧蹙。

    不管是因为伤了自尊心，还是单纯的看不上，“钱在哪里爱就在哪里”的攻略方法，显然是中道崩殂了。

    看到萧姚忧愁地揪头发，025幸灾乐祸地笑出鹅叫。

    【人员筛查完了？格式转化好了？任务刷出来了？都没有你还好意思笑？】

    025被怼自闭了，整个世界都安静了。

    萧姚盘腿托腮继续想撩汉桥段，正想得出神，突然被亮光晃了眼。

    定睛一瞧，原来是传讯纸鹤，而且是应原主要求特制的骚包明黄色纸鹤。

    萧姚指尖凝出灵力，轻轻一点，纸鹤两翅展开，记录的文字逐渐浮现——

    【来一趟！】

    萧姚悚然一惊。

    她那宠女如命的亲娘居然用了感叹号？

    她干啥了？

    萧姚不敢耽搁，麻溜地传送到主殿，蹬蹬蹬跑进去，二话不说跪在地上，双手放在膝盖上，乖巧地仰着头喊人：

    “娘，女儿来了。”

    萧季同一看萧姚那良好的认错态度，心里更凉了。

    她颤抖地伸手指着“不明所以先对不起”的萧姚，不可置信地问：

    “你……你当真看上了那个半妖？你居然为了他下跪求我？！”

    萧姚一脸迷茫。

    啊？

    “娘，姚儿没有……”

    “你连护心法器都给了他，还敢否认！”

    萧姚心里一跳。

    护心法器……是说那枚看起来就很华而不实的护心镜吗……

    好家伙，她氪金氪到大动脉了？

    “你葛叔说你胁迫外门弟子帮你亲近那只半妖，我本还不信，谁承想你竟天天往外门跑，还一掷千金！”

    萧季同痛心疾首。

    她的姚儿平日是贪玩了点，可她的眼光一向是好的，不是天之骄子根本入不得她的眼。

    纵然是被些皮相出众心性狡诈之辈蒙蔽，也是一两天就能看清对方本性，一刀两断。

    可这次竟将半条命都送了出去，可见是动了真情。

    这还了得？！

    “姚儿，谦谦君子心生向往，为娘理解。可他毕竟只是个半妖，他如何配得上你！”

    萧姚张口结舌。她有心辩解，最后却只干巴巴吐出一句话：

    “娘，他不一样。”

    他是个定时炸弹，跟那些没什么威胁的美人儿不一样。

    萧季同气个倒仰。

    是！这个是你的心头肉，跟其他撩完就扔的男修不一样！
content_en:
Xiao Yao stared at the mess in the surveillance camera, frowning.

Whether it's because of hurt self-esteem or simply looking down on him, the strategy of "love is where the money is" is clearly dead in the middle.

Seeing Xiao Yao pulling his hair sadly, 025 gloated and laughed like a goose.

[Has the personnel screening been completed?Has the format been converted?Is the task cleared?You still have the nerve to laugh even if you don’t?】

025 was silenced by the attack, and the whole world became quiet.

Xiao Yao crossed his legs and held his chin and continued to think about flirting with Han Qiao. He was lost in thought when he was suddenly dazzled by a bright light.

After taking a closer look, it turned out to be a message crane, a bright yellow paper crane specially made at the request of the original owner.

Xiao Yao condensed spiritual power on his fingertips, and with a slight tap, the wings of the paper crane spread out, and the recorded words gradually emerged——

【Come for a visit!】

Xiao Yao was shocked.

Her doting mother actually used an exclamation point?

What did she do?

Xiao Yao did not dare to delay, and teleported to the main hall in a hurry, ran in, knelt on the ground without saying a word, put his hands on his knees, raised his head obediently and shouted:

"Mom, my daughter is here."

Xiao Jitong felt even colder when he saw Xiao Yao's good attitude in admitting his mistakes.

She tremblingly pointed at Xiao Yao who said "I'm sorry for not knowing why" and asked in disbelief:

"You...you really have a crush on that half-demon? You actually knelt down and begged me for him?!"

Xiao Yao looked confused.

ah?

"Mom, Yao'er didn't..."

"You even gave him the heart-protecting magic weapon, and you still dare to deny it!"

Xiao Yao's heart skipped a beat.

The heart-protecting magic weapon...you mean that flashy-looking heart-protecting mirror...

Good guy, she's wasting her money on her arteries?

"Uncle Ge said that you coerced the outer sect disciples to help you get close to the half-demon. I didn't believe it at first. Who would have thought that you would go to the outer sect every day and spend a lot of money!"

Xiao Jitong was heartbroken.

Her Yao'er is usually a bit playful, but she has always had a good eye, and she would not be able to catch her eye unless she is the chosen one.

Even if you are deceived by someone with outstanding appearance and cunning heart, you can clearly see the other person's true nature in a day or two and make a clean break.

But this time he actually gave away half his life, which shows that he was truly moved.

Is this a big deal?!

"Yao'er, you are a humble gentleman, and I understand. But after all, he is only a half-demon, how can he be worthy of you!"

Xiao Yao was speechless.She wanted to defend herself, but in the end she just uttered one sentence:

"Mom, he is different."

He is a time bomb, unlike those beauties who pose no threat.

Xiao Jitong fell back in anger.

yes!This is your sweetheart, unlike other male cultivators who throw it away after flirting with it!
